meta.title: Price / Amount / Number column: prefix, suffix and precision

steps.note: Open the closest available pricing-sheet creation context.
Provide the required event title so the create flow remains usable.
Configure the context as an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply a pricing template so column controls become available.
Create a line item so the pricing sheet and column controls render.

args.goal: On the current RFQ pricing-sheet creation screen, open Add Columns and add one Price column, one Amount column, and one Number column. For each column, enter the column name using the test case's specified value, verify that the key attribute auto-fills from that name, enter the test case's specified prefix, suffix, and precision, save each column, and stop on the column settings or sheet screen showing the saved values.

steps.note: Perform and visually verify the column configuration that has no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the configuration completed without an application error.
